## Checklist

- [ ] One task, one branch, under two days old.
- [ ] Within the 400-line ceiling for non-test changes (CI checks this), or split.
- [ ] Tests pass locally: `python -m unittest discover -s scripts/test`.
- [ ] Green CI before merge; no skipped, disabled, or weakened tests.
- [ ] A test fails without this change and passes with it.
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, a rule, or a format changed.
- [ ] No release branch, no cherry-pick, no `develop`.
- [ ] No dead code or commented-out blocks.
- [ ] Branch will be deleted after merge.
